name: Niimura Hayato
source: The protagonist and third year student at Kamijou Academy. The student council vice president. Good grades and looks, also takes the surrounding atmosphere into account, he is very popular with the girls. Although he will take the surrounding circumstances into account, but somehow he managed to end up getting into an relationship with four girls, and is unable to reach a decision. Because of the girls, he is currently in the biggest crisis of his life. While the girls all wholeheartedly love him, he is just taking advantage of the situation to get laid and does not hold any special feelings towards them. He still does not know what true love is.
